fusions.name: Spore Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts spores from between your scales, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Slow Rot
fusions.desc: Hurls a rotting clod that deals 30 damage at up to 7 tiles, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Mycelial Coat
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lichen Cover
fusions.desc: Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter, your armour is 10% higher, and you regenerate 0.8 health a second permanently.
